seed_registration.claim_boundary: Repository registration only; no live process registration is claimed.

runtime.blocker: No live host state or runtime database was mounted for this repository-only refresh.

one_wire.blocker: No live One Wire guardian receipt was mounted. Loops 12 and 13 remain BLOCKED rather than inferring quorum from stale evidence.

evolution_archive.blocker: The live archive was not mounted; zeroes describe the audit environment, not the operator host.

verdict_tiers.HARNESS_PROVEN: A bounded replay/regression harness proves sense -> interpret -> constrain -> act -> adapt. It is not production-live closure.
verdict_tiers.CLOSED_LIVE: The loop is proven from its declared live owner surface with a later causal read and replayable evidence.
verdict_tiers.BLOCKED: A declared external or authority prerequisite is not presently verified.
